data_policy.verified_reference: Source-backed reference price/specification stored with source and date. It is an input to a valuation model, not a live market quote.
data_policy.catalogue_only: Model/brand seed exists, but reference pricing has not yet been verified. Never use legacy seed numbers for production valuation.
data_policy.historical_price: Use when the target registration year/generation matches the recorded historical price.
data_policy.market_comps: Comparable used-bike asking prices should be stored separately and given more weight as coverage grows.
data_policy.scope: India two-wheeler catalogue covering motorcycles, scooters, mopeds and electric two-wheelers represented in the reviewed manufacturer catalogues plus retained historical/legacy models from the baseline catalogue.
data_policy.verification_rule: Only directly reviewed source-backed facts are marked verified_reference. Unknown facts remain null/unknown. Legacy seed benchmarks are not treated as verified pricing.
data_policy.current_lineup_rule: Current status means the model was present in a directly reviewed manufacturer India product catalogue at the M2 review date. Presence in a historical baseline does not imply current availability.
data_policy.historical_rule: Historical model names are retained for used-bike valuation even when not current. Historical MSRP/generation records are only added when source-backed; no historical price is inferred from current MSRP.
